Name: More Abandoned Joja Mart Bundles Fix
Author: juminos
Description: If any mods add additional bundles to Abandoned Joja Mart, the junimo cutscene will play after completing the original bundle ("The Missing") the next time the player enters the building even if any of the additional bundles are incomplete. This mod prevents the scene from playing until all bundles are complete.

Manifest.Name: More Abandoned Joja Bundles
Manifest.Description: Prevents abandoned Joja repair cutscene from triggering before all bundles are complete.
Manifest.Author: juminos
